picks.name: Phase Fatale
picks.bio: Berlin DJ, producer and label owner, making his Dekmantel UFO series debut. "Off Desire" (July 3, 2026) is a four-track EP -- Immobile Symmetry, Guts, Blue Rose, Off Desire -- his first solo release in two years, with the title track a nod to his late friend and collaborator Silent Servant.
picks.why_listen: Driving, robotic techno with dystopian, EBM-adjacent textures -- a precise, hypnotic pick for a darker, more industrial-leaning stretch of a set.

picks.name: Efdemin
picks.bio: Phillip Sollmann, an enduring presence in techno since the early 2000s. "Mirror Phase EP" (July 17, 2026) is four precise, direct techno tracks -- Mirror Phase, FS1R, Unity Grain, Slip.
picks.why_listen: Confident, no-nonsense acid techno from a veteran producer -- reliable peak-time material to pair with the Phase Fatale pick above for a heavier stretch of a set.
